facts.fact: The OGP independent reviewers report that the E-Government Unit launched a national public data registry, enabling citizens to view and request inventoried data (registre.data.gov.tn); no launch date or dataset count is given, so the document date is used.

systems.owner: E-Government Unit, Presidency of the Government

note: Registry fact dated to document date; Mizaniatouna is an open budget portal with no download stated, so a systems entry only; National Open Data Strategy still awaits endorsement.
